params.name: symbols
params.description: One or more symbol identifiers, comma-separated.

items.docs: Retrieves real-time quote snapshots for one or more symbols. Returns current bid, ask, last price, volume, and other quote data fields. Supports stocks, options, futures, and cryptocurrency symbols.

params.name: symbol
params.description: The symbol to retrieve bar chart data for.

params.name: interval
params.description: The interval for each bar. For minute bars, valid values are 1-1440. For daily, weekly, and monthly bars, use 1.

params.name: unit
params.description: The unit of time for the bar interval.

params.name: barsBack
params.description: Number of bars to retrieve going back from the last date.

params.name: firstDate
params.description: The start date for bar data retrieval.

params.name: lastDate
params.description: The end date for bar data retrieval.

params.name: sessionTemplate
params.description: The session template to use for filtering bar data. Controls which trading session data to include.

items.docs: Retrieves historical bar chart data (OHLC) for a given symbol. Supports multiple intervals and units including minute, daily, weekly, and monthly bars. Returns open, high, low, close prices along with volume and timestamp information.

params.name: symbols

items.docs: Retrieves detailed symbol information for one or more symbols. Returns symbol metadata including description, exchange, category, currency, point value, and contract specifications.
